column1: Month = order Created at date (all timestamps +01:00); refunds belong to the order month
Revenue = line price × qty, less order discount spread pro rata by line value, less refunds, ÷ 1.20 (prices include 20% VAT)
Shipping charged to customers is kept out of revenue; the shipping part of refunds is kept out too
Partial refunds: amount only, spread across the order lines by value (the export has no line-level refund detail)
Full refunds on shipped orders: revenue zeroed, COGS kept (goods assumed not resaleable); no loss-maker had a refund in August
Excluded: orders tagged test, orders paid via "Bogus Gateway (for testing)" (4 untagged August orders), unshipped orders (pre-orders, voided, refunded before shipping)
SKU matching ignores case and spaces (cogs.csv has "gl-ser-030" and "GL-MST-050 ")
GL-NEW-001 Peptide Serum has no cost in cogs.csv: profit left blank, not estimated
Profit = product gross profit only: excludes payment fees, postage, packaging, ads and overheads
